title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Revelation 15: the sign of the seven angels, the song of Moses and the Lamb, and the seven golden bowls.

questions.text: What did the seven angels in the great and marvelous sign have?
questions.explanation: The narrator saw seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

questions.text: What did the sea that the narrator saw look like?
questions.explanation: He saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire.

answers.text: Like blood of a dead man

questions.text: What did those who overcame the beast have as they stood on the sea of glass?
questions.explanation: Those who overcame the beast, his image and the number of his name stood on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

questions.text: Which two songs did they sing?
questions.explanation: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb.

answers.text: A new song that no one else could learn
The song of the elders and of the living creatures
The song of the prophets and of the saints
The song of Moses and the song of the Lamb

questions.text: What do they call the ways of the Lord God in their song?
questions.explanation: They sing, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.”

questions.text: According to the song, what has been revealed?
questions.explanation: The song says, “For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

questions.text: What was opened in heaven after these things?
questions.explanation: The narrator looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

answers.text: The pit of the abyss in the earth
The book of life of the Lamb
The seventh seal of the little book
The temple of the tabernacle of the testimony

questions.text: How were the seven angels with the seven plagues clothed?
questions.explanation: They came out clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

answers.text: In pure, bright linen with golden sashes
In sackcloth, as the two witnesses
In long white robes washed in blood
In purple and scarlet with gold

questions.text: Who gave the seven angels the seven golden bowls?
questions.explanation: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

answers.text: One of the four living creatures

questions.text: What filled the temple, so that no one was able to enter it?
questions.explanation: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one was able to enter until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

answers.text: Smoke from the glory and the power of God
The wrath of God from seven bowls
A cloud with a rainbow in it
The incense of the prayers of the saints
